name: HaverCrown Dental
description: Family-owned dentistry on South Eagle Road in Havertown. Dr. Shafagh and the team keep modern care in a comforting room.

hero.headline: Your best interests, on Eagle Road
hero.sub: HaverCrown Dental is a local, family-owned practice. Dr. Shafagh and the team take the time to make the chair feel like a neighborhood office, not a mill.

offerings.heading: Modern care, comforting rooms.
items: Family dentistry for the people who already live in 19083.
Time in the chair for concerns you have been putting off.
A local team that still answers the phone at (610) 446-6688.

story.heading: Family owned on purpose
paragraphs: Welcome to HaverCrown Dental, where they say they have your best interests at heart. The office sits at 100 S Eagle Rd in Havertown.
Call (610) 446-6688. Confirm hours on the official site before you drive.

experience.heading: How a visit should go.
items: You call. A person picks up.
You sit. They listen before they plan.
You leave with a next step you can keep.

feature.heading: Comfort is the first clinical tool
feature.text: Dr. Shafagh and the team treat the fear of the chair as part of the job.

spotlight.heading: Havertown, not a chain lobby
spotlight.text: Family-owned means the same faces at the desk.

contact.heading: Find the office.
contact.sub: 100 S Eagle Rd, Havertown. Confirm hours before you drive.
